comment: Dr Crawford rushes through unclear lessons and has extremely high expectations for students. She is extremely disorganized. I will warn students not to take this class as long as I am a student here. If you blink, you will miss her whole presentation. The exams are much more difficult than the lessons entail, and her teaching is beyond frustrating.
Dr. Crawford gives engaging lectures and has reasonable expectations for students. She certainly makes psychology very interesting.
She's a good professor, and does her best to make the material easier. I would definitely take a class with her again.

Probably one of the smartest professors I have met.  She is young, well spoken, and is a wealth of information.  Crawford is also amazing at teaching--I never left the class confused about any of the material she covered.

Dr. Crawford knows so much and is always willing to try to teach it to others.  She is difficult only in that she expects the best from everyone.  If you really want to learn about cognitive psychology she is the best resource.
Gives really good examples, is very clear but doesn't cut you much slack
Very demanding, but I learned more in her class than I ever did in any other Psych classes.
